objective: Determine whether motif coverage distinguishes the independently discovered minimal line-family obstruction channels rather than serving as a universal nonzero-cycle condition.
rationale: EW-018 falsified universal motif necessity at full k3 but found complete motif coverage at repair-pruned k4.
EW-011 established two inclusion-minimal k3 obstruction channels H and V+D.
EW-006 established H+D as the unique inclusion-minimal k4 channel.
Testing motif coverage inside these fixed channels can distinguish channel-specific mechanism from generic correlation without inventing a new feature.
targeted_observations: fundamental zero/nonzero cycle motif coverage per minimal channel
contradictory reconvergence motif coverage per minimal channel
anti_circularity: line-family channels were fixed by prior counterfactual experiments
motif was fixed by EW-015 before this channel test
syndrome is read only after motif membership is computed
stopping_rule: If motif coverage differs by channel, record a channel-specific clue. If both channels contain motif-free nonzero cycles or both show similar mixed coverage, do not invent another motif refinement solely to force separation.
